name: Starlight Vega
source:
After moving into her grandfathers old house, Aria and Melody accidentally unleash the flirtatious demon, Lyria, who spent the past fifty years in a stone. 

A yuri visual novel with three romantic routes and different endings (including a harem end) based on your in-game choices.
translation:
搬进祖父的老房子后，阿丽亚和梅洛迪无意中释放了轻浮的恶魔莉莉亚，她在石头里度过了过去五十年。

一部尤里视觉小说，根据你在游戏中的选择，具有三种浪漫路线和不同的结局（包括后宫结局）。
